description: Audition song suggestions for every role across 22 musicals. Keyed by musical_id/role_id.

songs_to_prepare.title: I Know Now

songs_to_prepare.title: Wouldn't It Be Loverly

songs_to_prepare.title: Where Am I Going

songs_to_prepare.title: Broadway Baby

42nd-street/42nd-peggy.style_guidance: Bright soprano tone with a convincing belt. Peggy is luminous, not showy — think emotional clarity over power.

songs_to_prepare.title: The Music of the Night
songs_to_prepare.why: Commanding, obsessive baritone with range up to F4 — the visionary who controls everything

songs_to_prepare.title: Stars
songs_to_prepare.why: Authoritative, driving baritone — the man who cannot allow failure

songs_to_prepare.title: This Nearly Was Mine
songs_to_prepare.why: Romantic legit baritone showing the vulnerable side of a powerful man

songs_to_prepare.title: Being Alive
songs_to_prepare.why: A driven man confronting what he has sacrificed for his work

42nd-street/42nd-julian.style_guidance: Julian is a stern, driven director — cast for authority and presence first. Legit baritone, clean tone, commanding delivery.

songs_to_prepare.title: Everything's Coming Up Roses
songs_to_prepare.why: Brassy, demanding leading lady who refuses to be sidelined — belt and attitude

songs_to_prepare.title: Don't Rain on My Parade
songs_to_prepare.why: Star quality and unstoppable drive — shows the big soprano/mezzo belt Dorothy needs

songs_to_prepare.title: I'm Still Here
songs_to_prepare.why: The veteran theatrical star who has survived everything and refuses to fade

songs_to_prepare.title: You're Getting to Be a Habit with Me
songs_to_prepare.why: Dorothy's signature number — shows the diva sparkle and period style

42nd-street/42nd-dorothy.style_guidance: Dorothy needs a theatrical powerhouse with diva instincts — period-appropriate golden-age belt, comedic presence, and total star quality.

songs_to_prepare.title: Corner of the Sky
songs_to_prepare.why: Youthful tenor with ambition and swing energy — charismatic juvenile lead

songs_to_prepare.title: Lucky to Be Me
songs_to_prepare.why: Perfect leading-man swagger, period feel, bright tenor — exactly Billy's charm

songs_to_prepare.title: Luck Be a Lady
songs_to_prepare.why: Confident, showbiz-savvy leading man tenor/baritone

songs_to_prepare.title: There's No Business Like Show Business
songs_to_prepare.why: Quintessential Golden Age showbiz energy — the ensemble galvaniser

42nd-street/42nd-billy.style_guidance: Billy is the charming juvenile male lead — bright, energetic, period Golden Age style. Tap skills and charm matter as much as voice.
avoid: Heavy dramatic ballads — Billy is light, fast, and fun

songs_to_prepare.title: It's Today
songs_to_prepare.why: Comic character baritone with showbiz enthusiasm — big personality, broad delivery

songs_to_prepare.title: Comedy Tonight

songs_to_prepare.title: Sit Down, John
songs_to_prepare.why: Character baritone who talks over everyone — comic exasperation, broad physicality

42nd-street/42nd-bert.style_guidance: Pure character baritone — comic timing and stage presence over vocal brilliance. Bert is the lovable, flustered co-producer.
avoid: Romantic leading man material — this is a character comedy role

songs_to_prepare.title: Broadway Baby
songs_to_prepare.why: The definitive showgirl survival anthem — world-weary wit, big mezzo belt, perfectly aligned with Annie's soul

songs_to_prepare.title: Big Spender

songs_to_prepare.title: Don't Tell Mama
songs_to_prepare.why: Witty, knowing showgirl humour — Annie would absolutely sing this

songs_to_prepare.title: Nothing
songs_to_prepare.why: Mezzo with comedic storytelling and self-awareness — the chorus girl's survival instinct

42nd-street/42nd-annie.style_guidance: Annie is a survivor showgirl — knowing, funny, unflappable. Strong mezzo belt, comedic timing, and a wink. She has seen it all.
avoid: Sweet ingenue material — Annie is the opposite of innocent

songs_to_prepare.title: I'm Going Back
songs_to_prepare.why: Character alto/mezzo song with warm humour and theatrical savviness

songs_to_prepare.title: I Know
songs_to_prepare.why: Mezzo character moment — warm, perceptive, period-appropriate

songs_to_prepare.title: Before the Parade Passes By
songs_to_prepare.why: Alto/mezzo with heart and comic warmth — a woman who knows her value

42nd-street/42nd-maggie.style_guidance: Maggie is warmly comic and supportive — a strong alto/mezzo with personality and period style. Showcase warmth and wit over power.
avoid: Lead ingenue or powerhouse repertoire — Maggie is a supporting character role

songs_to_prepare.title: Steam Heat
songs_to_prepare.why: Dance-captain energy with jazzy mezzo/baritone swing character — exactly Andy's type

songs_to_prepare.title: All That Jazz
songs_to_prepare.why: Showbiz swagger and energy — if cast as a mezzo belt, this is the audition song

songs_to_prepare.title: Whatever Lola Wants
songs_to_prepare.why: Confident character, period feel, character baritone/mezzo quality

42nd-street/42nd-andy.style_guidance: Andy is the show's dance captain energy — versatile, punchy, physically committed. Voice supports the dance, not the other way around.

songs_to_prepare.title: If I Loved You
songs_to_prepare.why: Romantic baritone showing genuine feeling — Pat is Dorothy's true love, this shows sincerity

songs_to_prepare.title: I've Grown Accustomed to Her Face
songs_to_prepare.why: Understated romantic baritone — a man who loves but is powerless to change things

songs_to_prepare.title: Some Enchanted Evening
songs_to_prepare.why: Legit romantic baritone, period appropriate — shows the earnest leading-man quality Pat needs

42nd-street/42nd-pat.style_guidance: Pat is Dorothy's genuine love — warm, earnest, mid-range baritone. No fireworks needed; natural romantic sincerity wins this role.
avoid: Showboating material — Pat is understated and genuine

songs_to_prepare.title: I've Got the Horse Right Here
songs_to_prepare.why: Blustering, self-important comic character — the out-of-his-depth money man

songs_to_prepare.title: Comedy Tonight
songs_to_prepare.from: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum
songs_to_prepare.why: Character comedy energy — broad, physical, fundamentally silly

42nd-street/42nd-abner.style_guidance: Abner is primarily a spoken comedic role — cast for physical comedy and timing. Broad character voice over polished technique.
avoid: Legit singing numbers — this is a character/comic role first

songs_to_prepare.title: Broadway Baby
songs_to_prepare.why: Quintessential ensemble showgirl mezzo — drive, wit, and a strong chorus-line belt

songs_to_prepare.title: Dance: Ten; Looks: Three
songs_to_prepare.why: Mezzo chorus girl with personality and comedic edge — the survival instinct

songs_to_prepare.title: Big Spender
songs_to_prepare.why: Audition staple for showgirl mezzo roles of this era — attitude and belt

42nd-street/42nd-phyllis.style_guidance: Strong ensemble mezzo — personality, belt, period style, and the ability to tap dance while singing.
avoid: Soprano material — this role needs a real mezzo chest voice

songs_to_prepare.title: Broadway Baby
songs_to_prepare.why: Ensemble showgirl mezzo anthem — spirit, ambition, and a driven belt

songs_to_prepare.title: Nothing
songs_to_prepare.why: Mezzo character with personality and honesty — the chorus girl's perspective

songs_to_prepare.title: Somewhere That's Green
songs_to_prepare.why: Contrasting — lyric mezzo with dreamy vulnerability, shows range and softer qualities

42nd-street/42nd-lorraine.style_guidance: Ensemble principal mezzo — strong personality, period chorus girl energy, belt notes to D5.
avoid: Soprano roles — the show needs genuine mezzo chorus depth

songs_to_prepare.title: Comedy Tonight
songs_to_prepare.from: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum
songs_to_prepare.why: The organiser who keeps the show running — gruff, knowledgeable, dry wit

songs_to_prepare.title: Sit Down, John
songs_to_prepare.why: Commanding character baritone who herds chaos — the voice of authority and order

42nd-street/42nd-mac.style_guidance: Mac is the background authority figure who speaks command and efficiency. Character baritone precision over vocal range.
avoid: Leading man repertoire — Mac is a character/ensemble role

songs_to_prepare.title: Broadway Baby
songs_to_prepare.why: The chorus line dream — ambition, resilience, big belt, period-perfect style

songs_to_prepare.title: Dance: Ten; Looks: Three
songs_to_prepare.why: Shows chorus performer personality and comedic awareness — ideal for mezzo ensemble audition

songs_to_prepare.title: Lullaby of Broadway
songs_to_prepare.why: If auditioning for the production specifically — the show's showstopping chorus number

42nd-street/42nd-ensemble.style_guidance: This ensemble requires dancer-singers — tap skills are essential. Sing something Golden Age era that shows your belt and personality.

songs_to_prepare.title: Gimme Gimme

songs_to_prepare.title: Fight Song

songs_to_prepare.title: I Know the Truth
songs_to_prepare.why: Dramatic mezzo belt — a woman processed pain into power, exactly Juliet's arc

songs_to_prepare.title: Defying Gravity
songs_to_prepare.why: Anne is the feminist rewriter of the story — subversive, powerful, breaking the rules

songs_to_prepare.title: Still Hurting
songs_to_prepare.why: Contemporary mezzo-soprano processing the end of a relationship with intelligence and pain

songs_to_prepare.title: I Know the Truth
songs_to_prepare.why: Dramatic mezzo belt — a woman of intelligence and power facing hard truths

songs_to_prepare.title: Not for the Life of Me

and-juliet/and-juliet-anne-hathaway.style_guidance: Anne Hathaway is Shakespeare's smart, subversive wife — contemporary mezzo-soprano with wit, emotional depth, and feminist energy. She is not just support.

songs_to_prepare.title: Being Alive
songs_to_prepare.why: A man confronting what he has actually contributed and sacrificed — complex, meaty contemporary baritone

songs_to_prepare.title: Corner of the Sky
songs_to_prepare.why: The artist yearning to define his legacy — Shakespeare's internal struggle in song

songs_to_prepare.title: Agony
songs_to_prepare.why: Comic self-obsession perfectly matches Shakespeare's wounded ego — and shows baritone/tenor range

songs_to_prepare.title: Giants in the Sky

and-juliet/and-juliet-shakespeare.style_guidance: Shakespeare is a wounded, funny, self-important man who slowly grows — contemporary baritone/tenor with comedic range and emotional vulnerability.

songs_to_prepare.title: Somewhere
songs_to_prepare.why: Transcendent, gender-neutral longing — May's journey is about finding where they truly belong

songs_to_prepare.title: Stars and the Moon
songs_to_prepare.why: Contemporary musical theatre — a character asking profound questions about identity and love

songs_to_prepare.title: I Am What I Am
songs_to_prepare.why: Identity, authenticity, and pride — perfectly captures May's arc of self-discovery

songs_to_prepare.title: For Good
songs_to_prepare.why: Shows emotional depth and range — transformative growth works beautifully as a solo

and-juliet/and-juliet-may.style_guidance: May is a non-binary role requiring flexibility — contemporary voice that can blend and lead. Emotional authenticity and range matter more than traditional classification.

songs_to_prepare.title: Maria
songs_to_prepare.why: The original lovesick Romeo equivalent — bright lyric tenor, all-consuming young love

songs_to_prepare.title: Giants in the Sky
songs_to_prepare.why: A young man discovering the world is bigger and more complicated than he thought

songs_to_prepare.title: Corner of the Sky
songs_to_prepare.why: Youthful tenor longing — aspiration and identity, perfect for a young romantic lead

songs_to_prepare.title: Everything's Coming Up Roses
songs_to_prepare.why: Overpowering maternal force with a huge mezzo belt — exactly Angelique at full volume

songs_to_prepare.title: Before the Parade Passes By
songs_to_prepare.why: A woman deciding she is not going to be left behind — big mezzo declaration with comic fire

songs_to_prepare.title: Adelaide's Lament
songs_to_prepare.why: Comic mezzo/alto with personality and rubber-faced physicality — though Angelique is louder

songs_to_prepare.title: I Will Survive
songs_to_prepare.why: If pop is accepted — Angelique's entire character in three minutes

songs_to_prepare.title: Corner of the Sky
songs_to_prepare.why: A young man figuring out who he is and what he wants — lyric tenor with emotional openness

songs_to_prepare.title: Glad to Be Unhappy
songs_to_prepare.why: Tender, self-aware romantic tenor dealing with feelings he does not fully understand

songs_to_prepare.title: I Feel Pretty
songs_to_prepare.why: Joyful self-discovery — if Lance is played with comic lightness about his own emotions

and-juliet/and-juliet-lance.style_guidance: Lance is the sweet, earnest friend learning what real love and identity mean. Lyric tenor, gentle emotional intelligence.

songs_to_prepare.title: Maria

songs_to_prepare.title: On the Street Where You Live
songs_to_prepare.why: Lyric tenor romantic lead with a slightly elevated sense of himself — comic potential too

songs_to_prepare.title: Till There Was You
songs_to_prepare.why: Charming warm tenor who has discovered something wonderful — French romantic energy

and-juliet/and-juliet-francois.style_guidance: Francois is the charming, enthusiastic Frenchman — romantic, sincere, slightly comic. Lyric tenor with warmth.
avoid: Dark, brooding material — Francois is sunshine, not shadow

songs_to_prepare.title: Defying Gravity
songs_to_prepare.why: Contemporary pop-musical belt — shows the voice and drive this ensemble requires

songs_to_prepare.title: Gimme Gimme
songs_to_prepare.why: Belt anthem with contemporary energy — shows the pop-theatre voice this show needs

songs_to_prepare.title: Any Dream Will Do

songs_to_prepare.why: Pop-theatre sensibility, strong ensemble energy — shows versatility in the pop-musical genre

songs_to_prepare.why: Her defining opening — clean soprano tone, dramatic character, shows legit-to-belt transition

songs_to_prepare.title: Part of Your World
songs_to_prepare.why: Disney soprano sisters — the yearning girl who wants more, same composer, perfectly matched

songs_to_prepare.title: Wouldn't It Be Loverly
songs_to_prepare.why: The girl who wants more from her small-town life — exactly Belle, classic soprano

songs_to_prepare.title: On My Own
songs_to_prepare.why: Shows the romantic depth and belt capacity Belle needs — emotional scale and vocal control

songs_to_prepare.title: If I Can't Love Her
songs_to_prepare.why: The Beast's own signature piece — a powerful, emotionally raw baritone/tenor ballad

songs_to_prepare.title: The Music of the Night
songs_to_prepare.why: Tortured, isolated figure with huge vocal range and emotional complexity

songs_to_prepare.title: Anthem
songs_to_prepare.why: A man fighting for what he loves despite his own nature — dramatic, passionate tenor-baritone

songs_to_prepare.title: This Nearly Was Mine
songs_to_prepare.why: Romantic leading-man baritone who thought he had lost everything — deeply felt, classic

beauty-and-the-beast/batb-beast.style_guidance: The Beast needs power and vulnerability in equal measure — big raw voice that can show rage and tenderness. Range up to G4. Physical transformation reads in the performance.
avoid: Pure lyric baritone with no edge — The Beast must sound dangerous, not just sad

songs_to_prepare.title: I Am What I Am
songs_to_prepare.why: Absolute conviction in one's own greatness — big baritone, total self-assurance

songs_to_prepare.title: The Impossible Dream
songs_to_prepare.why: Delusional heroism delivered with complete sincerity — exactly Gaston's worldview

songs_to_prepare.title: Luck Be a Lady
songs_to_prepare.why: Swaggering baritone who believes destiny is on his side — showman energy, great range

songs_to_prepare.title: Sit Down, John
songs_to_prepare.why: Baritone who commands every room and cannot comprehend opposition — pompous, physical

songs_to_prepare.title: Comedy Tonight
songs_to_prepare.from: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum
songs_to_prepare.why: Comic tenor/baritone who lives to entertain and support — pure physical comedy in song

songs_to_prepare.title: I Am the Very Model
songs_to_prepare.why: Patter comedy for a tenor/baritone who needs fast delivery and physical commitment

songs_to_prepare.title: Buddy's Blues
songs_to_prepare.why: Self-aware comic character devoted to someone who doesn't deserve it — LeFou in a nutshell

songs_to_prepare.title: Springtime for Hitler
songs_to_prepare.why: Outrageous comic tenor who sells the unsellable with complete commitment

beauty-and-the-beast/batb-lefou.style_guidance: LeFou is physical comedy first, voice second — character tenor/baritone who makes the audience howl. Modern productions give him a full arc; look for both comedy and heart.

songs_to_prepare.title: Be Our Guest
songs_to_prepare.why: The showman's showstopper — everything Lumière is, all at once

songs_to_prepare.title: Make Someone Happy
songs_to_prepare.why: Charming, romantic tenor/baritone — the lover who makes joy out of every moment

songs_to_prepare.title: C'est Moi
songs_to_prepare.why: The impossibly confident Frenchman who has never doubted his own magnificence

songs_to_prepare.title: Love, I Hear
songs_to_prepare.from: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum
songs_to_prepare.why: Romantic comic tenor — charming, light, period-adjacent showman energy

beauty-and-the-beast/batb-lumiere.style_guidance: Lumière is the sophisticated French showman — warm, confident, romantic, and irresistible. Tenor-leaning baritone with a gift for spectacle and wit.
avoid: Heavy dramatic material — Lumière is lightness and charm, not weight

songs_to_prepare.title: I Am the Very Model
songs_to_prepare.why: The prissy, over-educated, rule-obsessed British character — Cogsworth's soul in one song

songs_to_prepare.title: I've Got a Little List
songs_to_prepare.why: Pedantic, listing, gleefully disapproving British character baritone — Cogsworth to a T

songs_to_prepare.title: Sit Down, John
songs_to_prepare.why: The character who needs ORDER and cannot cope when others won't comply — exasperated and comic

beauty-and-the-beast/batb-cogsworth.style_guidance: Cogsworth is an uptight, fussy, loveable British character baritone — comic timing and clipped delivery over vocal range. Think Gilbert and Sullivan crossed with Basil Fawlty.

songs_to_prepare.title: Beauty and the Beast
songs_to_prepare.why: Mrs. Potts's signature song — warm, lyric mezzo, gentle and wise

songs_to_prepare.title: So Big/So Small
songs_to_prepare.why: Maternal warmth and controlled emotion — a mother's love expressed with restraint and power

songs_to_prepare.title: Children Will Listen
songs_to_prepare.why: The wise, caring adult voice — mezzo with gentle authority, the emotional centre of the story

songs_to_prepare.title: What I Did for Love
songs_to_prepare.why: Simple, heartfelt, warm mezzo — no tricks, just genuine feeling, exactly Mrs. Potts

beauty-and-the-beast/batb-mrs-potts.style_guidance: Mrs. Potts is warmth and reassurance incarnate — gentle alto/mezzo with natural authority and maternal love. No fireworks; pure sincerity.

songs_to_prepare.title: Castle on a Cloud
songs_to_prepare.why: Innocent child voice with sweet treble tone — vulnerable and pure

songs_to_prepare.title: Tomorrow
songs_to_prepare.why: The classic child soprano audition piece — shows treble range and innocent optimism

beauty-and-the-beast/batb-chip.style_guidance: Chip is a sweet, curious child — clear treble tone, natural innocence, bright personality. Do not oversing; let the youth be the charm.
avoid: Adult material — Chip needs a genuinely childlike quality, not precocious performance

songs_to_prepare.title: Diamonds Are a Girl's Best Friend
songs_to_prepare.why: Flirtatious, playful, French soprano — Babette's character in one iconic number

songs_to_prepare.title: Shall We Dance
songs_to_prepare.why: Sparkling soprano with warmth and physical joy — romantic and light

songs_to_prepare.title: I Can't Help Lovin' Dat Man
songs_to_prepare.why: Warm, flirtatious soprano/mezzo showing genuine romantic feeling with period feel

beauty-and-the-beast/batb-babette.style_guidance: Babette is flirtatious, charming, and thoroughly French — soprano/mezzo with sparkle and wit. Light touch, great comic timing, physical expressiveness.
avoid: Heavy dramatic material — Babette is feathers and flirtation, not depth and gravitas

songs_to_prepare.title: Sunrise, Sunset
songs_to_prepare.why: Warm, paternal bass-baritone cherishing the child who is his entire world

songs_to_prepare.title: The Impossible Dream
songs_to_prepare.why: The earnest eccentric who believes in impossible things — Maurice's whole spirit

songs_to_prepare.title: Make Them Hear You
songs_to_prepare.why: Character baritone moment of conviction — a man who will not stop believing in what he loves

beauty-and-the-beast/batb-maurice.style_guidance: Maurice is warm, bumbling, and genuinely eccentric — baritone/bass with natural warmth and slightly distracted otherworldliness. He loves Belle entirely and unconditionally.

songs_to_prepare.title: Glitter and Be Gay
songs_to_prepare.why: Operatic soprano comedy masterpiece — dramatic, self-aware, excessive, and brilliant

songs_to_prepare.title: The Saga of Jennie
songs_to_prepare.why: Big theatrical soprano with comic intelligence — the wise woman who has seen everything

songs_to_prepare.title: Diva's Lament
songs_to_prepare.why: The theatrical diva who knows her worth and will not let anyone forget it — perfect for Wardrobe

beauty-and-the-beast/batb-madame-wardrob.style_guidance: The Wardrobe is an operatic diva trapped in furniture — soprano with genuine operatic range, theatrical excess, and wonderful comic self-importance. The bigger the voice and personality, the better.

songs_to_prepare.title: Belle (Opening)
songs_to_prepare.why: The ensemble's big opening — shows ability to blend lyric soprano sound with period Disney style

songs_to_prepare.title: Be Our Guest
songs_to_prepare.why: The showstopper — ensemble vitality, timing, and ability to be a specific character object

songs_to_prepare.title: Any Dream Will Do
songs_to_prepare.from: Joseph and the Amazing Technicolor Dreamcoat
songs_to_prepare.why: Versatile vocal style — lyric with warmth, good for showing ensemble blend quality

beauty-and-the-beast/batb-ensemble.style_guidance: Disney ensemble — warm, clear tone that blends, strong physicality for transformative character work (you may play a teapot, a clock, or a wolf), commitment to the world.
avoid: Pop-heavy audition pieces — Beauty and the Beast calls for warm, legit ensemble sound

songs_to_prepare.title: Being Alive
songs_to_prepare.why: Bobby/Bobbie's defining number — the central character finally opening up to connection

songs_to_prepare.title: Marry Me a Little
songs_to_prepare.why: Shows the character's ambivalence about commitment — intimate, unguarded, beautifully complex

songs_to_prepare.title: Finishing the Hat

songs_to_prepare.why: The brilliant observer who holds themselves apart from life — the observer's internal world

songs_to_prepare.title: The Road You Didn't Take
songs_to_prepare.why: A person confronting what their choices have cost them — understated, chilling, sophisticated

songs_to_prepare.title: The Lady Is a Tramp

songs_to_prepare.title: Losing My Mind

songs_to_prepare.title: Sunrise, Sunset
songs_to_prepare.why: Ancient, warm, paternal bass-baritone — the elder who knows more than he can say

songs_to_prepare.title: Make Them Hear You
songs_to_prepare.why: Deep, resonant character bass-baritone with gravitas and settled conviction

frozen/frozen-pabbie.style_guidance: Pabbie is ancient wisdom — low bass-baritone with gentleness and depth. Settles the audience with calm authority. Secondary role.
avoid: Young or aggressive material — Pabbie is primordial gentleness

songs_to_prepare.title: It's Today
songs_to_prepare.why: Warm, gregarious, overwhelming character baritone who is delighted by everything including you

songs_to_prepare.title: Comedy Tonight
songs_to_prepare.from: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum
songs_to_prepare.why: Character who makes every transaction into a theatrical event

frozen/frozen-oaken.style_guidance: Oaken is cheerfully enormous — big voice, big personality, big family, big sauna. Character baritone with maximum warmth and zero social radar.
avoid: Restrained material — Oaken does everything at full volume with complete enthusiasm

songs_to_prepare.title: Castle on a Cloud
songs_to_prepare.why: A frightened child dreaming of safety and warmth — pure treble with emotional vulnerability

songs_to_prepare.title: In My Own Little Corner
songs_to_prepare.why: The child who retreats into imagination from a world that doesn't understand her

frozen/frozen-young-elsa.style_guidance: Young Elsa carries enormous fear in a small voice — clear treble with genuine emotional fragility. The opening scenes land on this actress.
avoid: Powerful or adult material — Young Elsa is a frightened little girl, not a star

songs_to_prepare.title: Tomorrow
songs_to_prepare.why: The irrepressibly optimistic child — Young Anna condensed into three minutes

songs_to_prepare.title: Do Re Mi
songs_to_prepare.why: Pure childhood energy with a bright, clean treble — fun and absolutely zero filter

frozen/frozen-young-anna.style_guidance: Young Anna is pure sunshine and chaos — bright, warm child voice with comedian instincts. She bounces off walls including Elsa.
avoid: Quiet or introspective material — Young Anna has one gear: enthusiastic

songs_to_prepare.title: Gauntlet (Popular)
songs_to_prepare.why: Strong ensemble with character specificity — each Arendellian has a story

songs_to_prepare.title: Any Dream Will Do
songs_to_prepare.from: Joseph and the Amazing Technicolor Dreamcoat
songs_to_prepare.why: Warm, versatile ensemble voice with lyric quality — Disney-adjacent style

frozen/frozen-ensemble-townspeople.style_guidance: Arendelle townspeople — warm, lyric ensemble sound with the ability to convey both celebration and fear. Frozen is a big-emotion show requiring committed ensemble work.
avoid: Pop-only approach — Frozen's ensemble writing is predominantly lyric/legit

songs_to_prepare.title: Be Our Guest
songs_to_prepare.why: Ensemble magic creatures — committed physicality, character work, and ensemble singing

frozen/frozen-ensemble-hidden-folk.style_guidance: Troll folk require strong physicality and character specificity — they are ancient, earthy, and lovingly meddlesome. Ensemble work with physical character transformation.
avoid: Realistic human physicality — trolls move and sing differently from humans

songs_to_prepare.title: Defying Gravity
songs_to_prepare.why: Soprano/alto ensemble with power behind lyricism — shows the choral voice Frozen requires

songs_to_prepare.title: I Am the Very Model
songs_to_prepare.why: Demonstrates strong soprano/alto ensemble blend and musical precision

frozen/frozen-ensemble-snow-chorus.style_guidance: Snow Chorus is the ethereal choral body of the show — soprano/alto voices that blend beautifully, with the ability to convey both wonder and danger through pure tone.
avoid: Heavy belt for this ensemble — Snow Chorus is primarily lyric/legit in quality

songs_to_prepare.title: Out There
songs_to_prepare.why: Quasimodo's defining number — a soaring tenor cry for freedom from someone who has never had it

songs_to_prepare.title: The Music of the Night
songs_to_prepare.why: Another isolated, physically marked man believing in the world's beauty — tenor with ache

songs_to_prepare.title: Being Good Isn't Good Enough
songs_to_prepare.why: Earnest tenor who has done everything right and still gets no recognition — Quasimodo's frustration

songs_to_prepare.title: Anthem
songs_to_prepare.why: Passionate tenor/high baritone claiming identity against an indifferent world — climactic power

hunchback-of-notre-dame/hunchback-quasim.style_guidance: Quasimodo needs a high tenor with emotional rawness — out there to A4 is mandatory. The role requires genuine vulnerability and yearning, not just power. The bell tower is loneliness made musical.
avoid: Playing the disability — Quasimodo's spirit soars, the physical restriction is context, not character

songs_to_prepare.title: Hellfire
songs_to_prepare.why: Frollo's terrifying soliloquy — bass-baritone who turns religious conviction into obsessive desire

songs_to_prepare.title: Stars
songs_to_prepare.why: The great antagonist bass-baritone who believes God is on his side — righteous and terrifying

songs_to_prepare.title: The Music of the Night
songs_to_prepare.why: Obsessive, controlling baritone who believes his darkness is beautiful — the same shadow energy

songs_to_prepare.title: Epiphany
songs_to_prepare.why: The moment a controlled man's darkness fully escapes — chilling bass-baritone of absolute conviction

hunchback-of-notre-dame/hunchback-frollo.style_guidance: Frollo is one of the great musical theatre villains — a bass-baritone whose terror comes from total sincerity. He is not evil to himself. He believes in his righteousness absolutely.
avoid: Broad pantomime villain energy — Frollo's menace comes from cold conviction, not twirling

songs_to_prepare.title: God Help the Outcasts
songs_to_prepare.why: Esmeralda's own prayer — mezzo-soprano with spiritual conviction and raw emotional truth

songs_to_prepare.title: Don't Rain on My Parade
songs_to_prepare.why: Unstoppable mezzo-soprano force — the woman who will not be contained or defined by others

songs_to_prepare.title: I Know the Truth
songs_to_prepare.why: Dramatic mezzo belt — a woman with compassion and strength facing an unjust world

songs_to_prepare.title: Somewhere
songs_to_prepare.why: The yearning for a world without persecution — Esmeralda's deepest wish in musical form

hunchback-of-notre-dame/hunchback-esmera.style_guidance: Esmeralda is compassion and defiance in equal parts — mezzo-soprano who can deliver a folk-inflected belt and a spiritual legit line. She believes in justice with every note.
avoid: Passive, gentle material — Esmeralda is fierce, not soft, even in her most vulnerable moments

songs_to_prepare.title: The Impossible Dream
songs_to_prepare.why: The soldier becoming a man of conscience — baritone/tenor who discovers honour mid-story

songs_to_prepare.title: Anthem
songs_to_prepare.why: A man who has served institutions and now serves something higher — passionate, climactic baritone

songs_to_prepare.title: Being Alive
songs_to_prepare.why: A man confronting what truly matters — Phoebus's arc is about awakening to real love and justice

hunchback-of-notre-dame/hunchback-phoebu.style_guidance: Phoebus begins as a pragmatist and becomes a hero — baritone/tenor with inherent warmth and the capacity for moral growth. He needs to be believably both a soldier and a romantic.
avoid: Cold, calculating material — Phoebus's conversion to conscience must feel genuine

songs_to_prepare.title: Comedy Tonight
songs_to_prepare.from: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum
songs_to_prepare.why: The theatrical MC who sets the tone for the whole show — showman energy, control of the audience

songs_to_prepare.title: Not While I'm Around
songs_to_prepare.why: Shows tenor baritone with complex moral ambiguity — Clopin protects his people but by any means

songs_to_prepare.title: Willkommen
songs_to_prepare.why: The great theatrical host who welcomes you to a world that may or may not be safe — exactly Clopin

hunchback-of-notre-dame/hunchback-clopin.style_guidance: Clopin is the trickster narrator — tenor/baritone with maximum theatrical flair, physical showmanship, and the ability to be charming and dangerous in the same breath.
avoid: Straight leading man energy — Clopin's power is unpredictability and total control over the audience's perspective

songs_to_prepare.title: Comedy Tonight
songs_to_prepare.from: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum
songs_to_prepare.why: Character voice trio — comic support for Quasimodo, each with a distinct physical and vocal personality

songs_to_prepare.title: I've Got a Little List
songs_to_prepare.why: Character voices with wit and physical expressiveness — the gargoyles are Quasi's imagination

hunchback-of-notre-dame/hunchback-gargoy.style_guidance: The gargoyles are Quasimodo's fractured inner voices — comic, loving, and ultimately revealed as projections. Each needs a distinct physical and vocal identity. Character work over vocal range.
avoid: Realistic, grounded physicality — they are stone, imagination, and comic energy

songs_to_prepare.title: Corner of the Sky
songs_to_prepare.why: The young man who made bad choices looking for something real — tenor regret and longing

songs_to_prepare.title: Giants in the Sky
songs_to_prepare.why: A man who went out into the world and found it darker than expected — tenor self-examination

hunchback-of-notre-dame/hunchback-jehan.style_guidance: Jehan is the wayward brother — tenor with tragedy baked in. His choices explain much of Frollo's severity. Lyric quality with underlying sadness.
avoid: Villainous or cold material — Jehan is a cautionary figure, not a villain

songs_to_prepare.title: Sit Down, John
songs_to_prepare.why: Commanding baritone authority figure with historical gravity — saint as dramatic presence

hunchback-of-notre-dame/hunchback-saint-.style_guidance: Saint Aphrodisius is a supporting spiritual role — baritone with gravitas and presence. Secondary character requiring dramatic commitment within limited material.
avoid: Comic treatment — this is a solemn historical/spiritual figure

songs_to_prepare.title: My Man's Gone Now
songs_to_prepare.why: Mezzo-soprano of folk/ethnic musical heritage carrying grief and strength — Esmeralda's mother

songs_to_prepare.title: Somewhere
songs_to_prepare.why: The yearning for a safe place for your children — mezzo with tragedy and love

hunchback-of-notre-dame/hunchback-florik.style_guidance: Florika is Esmeralda's Romani mother — mezzo-soprano with folk warmth and deep tragedy. Her brief role carries enormous backstory and emotional weight.
avoid: Legit classical soprano style — Florika's voice should carry the sound of the margins, not the concert hall

songs_to_prepare.title: Make Them Hear You
songs_to_prepare.why: Principled baritone character with moral conviction — a priest who actually means it

hunchback-of-notre-dame/hunchback-father.style_guidance: Father Dupin is a supporting religious character — warm baritone who represents genuine faith rather than Frollo's weaponised version. Secondary role with moral clarity.
avoid: Dark or authoritarian material — Father Dupin is kindness, not power

songs_to_prepare.title: Giants in the Sky
songs_to_prepare.why: Military baritone/tenor following orders — the man who chose institution over conscience

hunchback-of-notre-dame/hunchback-freder.style_guidance: Lieutenant Charlus is a supporting military role — baritone/tenor who serves the system. Shows how ordinary people enable extraordinary evil through compliance.
avoid: Scene-stealing material — this is a supporting role that serves the larger moral picture

songs_to_prepare.title: I've Got the Horse Right Here
songs_to_prepare.why: Speaking/character role — shows commanding presence and timing without musical demand

hunchback-of-notre-dame/hunchback-king-l.style_guidance: King Louis XI is primarily a speaking royal authority role — cast for presence, bearing, and timing. Physical majesty required.
avoid: Singing-heavy audition pieces — this is a character speaking role

songs_to_prepare.title: Hellfire (choral section)
songs_to_prepare.why: The show's choral writing is massive — four-part SATB with operatic scope

songs_to_prepare.title: Anthem
songs_to_prepare.why: Shows operatic choral capacity — this ensemble is closer to oratorio than typical musical theatre

songs_to_prepare.title: Defying Gravity
songs_to_prepare.why: Strong ensemble belt and choral blend — shows upper register capacity

hunchback-of-notre-dame/hunchback-congre.style_guidance: Hunchback requires a real SATB choir — this is not standard musical theatre ensemble. Directors should cast singers with choral training who can also act. The choral passages have near-operatic scope.
avoid: Pop-belt only ensemble — the choir writing requires genuine four-part classical choral skill

songs_to_prepare.title: No More
songs_to_prepare.why: The Baker's own defining number — baritone processing grief and responsibility with raw honesty

songs_to_prepare.title: Being Alive
songs_to_prepare.why: The everyman confronting what it means to truly connect — Sondheim in the Baker's exact register

songs_to_prepare.title: Take Me to the World
songs_to_prepare.why: Simple, aching domestic baritone — a man who wants the ordinary things that feel impossible

songs_to_prepare.title: Giants in the Sky
songs_to_prepare.why: Shows the range and style — can be used as contrasting material from the same composer/show

into-the-woods/the-baker.style_guidance: The Baker is Sondheim's modern everyman — baritone with emotional intelligence and the specific quality of a good man overwhelmed by events. Conversational delivery, not operatic.
avoid: Heroic tenor material — The Baker is a baker, not a hero, and that is entirely the point

songs_to_prepare.title: Moments in the Woods
songs_to_prepare.why: The Baker's Wife's defining solo — mezzo-soprano processing a spontaneous choice with intelligence and honesty

songs_to_prepare.title: Not a Day Goes By
songs_to_prepare.why: The Sondheim mezzo soprano voice — complex, simultaneous feelings, sophisticated delivery

songs_to_prepare.title: My Favorite Things
songs_to_prepare.why: Contrasting — warm mezzo-soprano with aspiration and a gift for subtext

songs_to_prepare.title: Losing My Mind
songs_to_prepare.why: Shows the complexity of desire that co-exists with genuine love — the Baker's Wife's specific dilemma

into-the-woods/the-bakers-wife.style_guidance: The Baker's Wife is the show's most psychologically complex character — mezzo-soprano with intelligence, wit, and the ability to hold contradictions simultaneously. She is the smartest person on stage.
avoid: Simple romantic lead material — she is Sondheim's most complex woman, not a supporting wife

songs_to_prepare.title: Children Will Listen
songs_to_prepare.why: The Witch's devastating conclusion — mezzo-soprano powerhouse stripping down to cold truth

songs_to_prepare.title: Last Midnight
songs_to_prepare.why: The moment the Witch declares herself done — chilling, precise, and requires full mezzo range

songs_to_prepare.title: Rose's Turn
songs_to_prepare.why: The woman who controlled through love and is left with nothing — identical energy to the Witch's arc

songs_to_prepare.title: Defying Gravity
songs_to_prepare.why: Another mezzo-soprano powerhouse who chooses not to be good — the same complex moral position

into-the-woods/the-witch.style_guidance: The Witch is the show's anchor — mezzo-soprano with genuine power to G5 combined with verbal precision. She is simultaneously right and wrong and she knows it. Never play her as a villain.
avoid: Panto witch clichés — the Witch's power is ambiguity and intelligence, not evil

songs_to_prepare.title: On the Steps of the Palace
songs_to_prepare.why: Shows Cinderella's specific voice — soprano with verbal agility, intelligence, and the famous frozen decision

songs_to_prepare.title: No One Is Alone
songs_to_prepare.why: Shows the lyric warmth and emotional generosity this soprano must carry

songs_to_prepare.title: Somewhere
songs_to_prepare.why: Legit soprano yearning with genuine emotional depth

songs_to_prepare.title: I Feel Pretty
songs_to_prepare.why: Shows the lighter, more comedic side — Cinderella in Act One before she has questions

into-the-woods/cinderella.style_guidance: ITW's Cinderella is the most complex version of this character — soprano who starts as a fairy tale type and becomes a thinking, questioning woman. Legit quality essential with the ability to deliver rapid Sondheim text.
avoid: Pure Disney princess soprano with no intelligence underneath — this Cinderella has agency and doubts

songs_to_prepare.title: Giants in the Sky
songs_to_prepare.why: Jack's own defining number — tenor discovering a world beyond his imagination, wonder and terror

songs_to_prepare.title: Corner of the Sky
songs_to_prepare.why: Young man who set out into the world and found more than he bargained for

songs_to_prepare.title: All I Need Is the Girl
songs_to_prepare.why: Young male naivety and endearing confidence — the boy who doesn't know what he doesn't know

into-the-woods/jack.style_guidance: Jack is the boy who is too young for the consequences he triggers — tenor with genuine youth, wonder, and zero comprehension of cause and effect. He is never dumb, just incomplete.
avoid: Calculating or knowing performance — Jack's tragedy is that he acts from pure feeling, every time

songs_to_prepare.title: I Know Things Now
songs_to_prepare.why: Little Red's post-wolf education — soprano/belt showing the character's dawning awareness

songs_to_prepare.title: Not While I'm Around
songs_to_prepare.why: Contrasting — shows the innocent child's fierce protective instinct, different tone from the comic scenes

songs_to_prepare.title: Wouldn't It Be Loverly
songs_to_prepare.why: Shows the young soprano with appetite and pragmatism — Little Red BEFORE the woods

into-the-woods/little-red-riding-hood.style_guidance: Little Red is the show's most rapidly maturing character — bright soprano with physical energy and the ability to go from oblivious to knowing within a scene. Comic and then chilling.
avoid: Sweet, innocent-only performance — Little Red's whole arc is the loss of innocent obliviousness

songs_to_prepare.title: Agony
songs_to_prepare.why: The Prince's own comic duet — everything about this character in two-and-a-half minutes of glorious self-obsession

songs_to_prepare.title: Willkommen
songs_to_prepare.why: Seductive baritone who is entirely aware of his own effect — glamour without depth

songs_to_prepare.title: Some Enchanted Evening
songs_to_prepare.why: Romantic baritone who falls completely for the fantasy — then proves entirely unable to live up to it

into-the-woods/cinderellas-prince.style_guidance: The Princes are the show's great comic deconstruction of romantic heroes — handsome, useless, completely sincere about their own suffering. Play it absolutely straight. The comedy comes from total earnestness.
avoid: Knowing winks about the comedy — any self-awareness kills the joke. These princes are perfectly serious.

songs_to_prepare.title: Agony
songs_to_prepare.why: Both Princes share this comic masterpiece — identical guidance to Cinderella's Prince

songs_to_prepare.title: The Impossible Dream
songs_to_prepare.why: Delusional romantic conviction delivered with complete sincerity — the Prince believes every word

into-the-woods/rapunzels-prince.style_guidance: Same as Cinderella's Prince — comic romantic hero who is absolutely convinced of his own anguished nobility. The earnestness IS the performance. Baritone with range and complete self-belief.
avoid: Ironic performance — if either Prince seems to know they are funny, the show loses one of its best gags

songs_to_prepare.title: In My Own Little Corner
songs_to_prepare.why: Pure soprano dreaming from isolation — the precise emotional reality of a girl in a tower

songs_to_prepare.title: Castle on a Cloud
songs_to_prepare.why: The lonely child's dream of warmth and freedom — Rapunzel pre-wedding, all longing

songs_to_prepare.title: Glitter and Be Gay
songs_to_prepare.why: If a more comic approach — shows soprano range and the brittle brightness of someone trying to adapt

into-the-woods/rapunzel.style_guidance: Rapunzel is a pure lyric soprano — she goes mad quietly, which is one of the show's darkest moments. The contrast between her ethereal beauty and her fragmentation must be present from the start.
avoid: Belty or contemporary pop approach — Rapunzel is pure legit soprano, specifically chosen to contrast with the Witch

songs_to_prepare.title: Rose's Turn
songs_to_prepare.why: The mother at the end of her rope, loving and maddened — soprano/mezzo with exasperation and genuine fear

songs_to_prepare.title: Far From the Home I Love
songs_to_prepare.why: A mother facing terrible choices to protect her child — warmth, grief, and pragmatism

into-the-woods/jacks-mother.style_guidance: Jack's Mother is poverty, love, and frustration in one package — soprano/mezzo with roughness under the warmth. She is managing disaster with dignity.
avoid: Gentle, refined soprano — Jack's Mother is poor, harried, and running out of options

songs_to_prepare.title: Old Friends
songs_to_prepare.why: A Sondheim baritone who carries the story's weight — observational, warm, slightly complicit

songs_to_prepare.title: The Road You Didn't Take
songs_to_prepare.why: The man watching other people's stories with full knowledge of outcome — the Mysterious Man in song form

into-the-woods/narrator-mysterious-man.style_guidance: The Narrator/Mysterious Man is the show's meta-theatrical conscience — warm baritone with intelligence and slight sadness. He knows more than the characters and eventually must enter the story.
avoid: Detached or cold performance — the Narrator loves these characters even as he chronicles their mistakes

songs_to_prepare.title: Everything's Coming Up Roses
songs_to_prepare.why: The mother who will sacrifice everything — including her children's health — for social ambition

songs_to_prepare.title: I'm Still Here
songs_to_prepare.why: The woman who clawed her way to respectability and will die before she lets anyone take it — mezzo with teeth

into-the-woods/cinderellas-stepmother.style_guidance: The Stepmother is social climbing with a beautiful veneer and vicious core — mezzo-soprano with sharp delivery and a smile that doesn't reach the eyes. She is the show's comic villain.
avoid: Broad cackling villain — the Stepmother thinks she is being entirely reasonable and that is far funnier

songs_to_prepare.title: Popular
songs_to_prepare.why: The girl who is convinced her mediocrity is excellence — mezzo with comedy and total self-belief

songs_to_prepare.title: I Enjoy Being a Girl
songs_to_prepare.why: Mezzo character who is thoroughly pleased with herself — charming, slightly dim, absolutely confident

into-the-woods/florinda.style_guidance: Florinda is the stepsister who literally cuts off her heel to fit the slipper — mezzo with physical comedy and absolute conviction of her own worthiness. She and Lucinda are a double act.
avoid: Knowing self-deprecation — the stepsisters are completely sincere in their delusion

songs_to_prepare.title: Popular
songs_to_prepare.why: Same stepsister energy as Florinda — complete conviction of superiority

songs_to_prepare.title: Diamonds Are a Girl's Best Friend
songs_to_prepare.why: Mezzo character who is thoroughly invested in social status and completely sure of her own charm

into-the-woods/lucinda.style_guidance: Mirror image of Florinda — mezzo with the same combination of physical comedy, total self-belief, and complete obliviousness. The stepsisters should feel like an act.
avoid: Malicious reading — the stepsisters aren't evil, they're just spectacular idiots

songs_to_prepare.title: Hello, Young Lovers
songs_to_prepare.why: Seductive baritone who watches the young with predatory warmth — exactly The Wolf's register

songs_to_prepare.title: The Music of the Night
songs_to_prepare.why: Dark seduction — the powerful figure drawing in the innocent with honeyed voice

into-the-woods/the-wolf.style_guidance: The Wolf is sexual menace in a top hat — baritone with pure seductive danger. The role is deliberately uncomfortable and that discomfort is the theatrical point. Lush voice, predatory physicality.
avoid: Comic reading — The Wolf is genuinely threatening beneath the theatrical glamour

songs_to_prepare.title: Not While I'm Around
songs_to_prepare.why: The spirit of pure protective motherhood from the grave — lyric soprano with warmth and gentle authority

songs_to_prepare.title: Climb Ev'ry Mountain
songs_to_prepare.why: Soprano with spiritual authority — gentle, elevated, and guiding from a safe remove

into-the-woods/cinderellas-mother.style_guidance: Cinderella's Mother is a pure lyric soprano spirit — ethereal, warm, and guiding. A small role with enormous impact when cast with a genuinely beautiful pure soprano tone.
avoid: Belt or character approach — Cinderella's Mother should float above the story, not anchor it

songs_to_prepare.title: Comedy Tonight
songs_to_prepare.from: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum
songs_to_prepare.why: The official functionary who represents institutional order — character presenter role

into-the-woods/the-steward.style_guidance: The Steward is a small ensemble/character speaking role — cast for physical presence and timing. He represents the royal hierarchy at work.
avoid: Large vocal showcase — this is a supporting character role

songs_to_prepare.title: Physical Theatre Demonstration
songs_to_prepare.why: Milky White is a non-speaking physical role — show physical mime, relationship dynamics, and character commitment

into-the-woods/milky-white.style_guidance: Milky White is a pure physical theatre role — cast entirely on movement, comic timing, and the ability to form a convincing and endearing cow-actor relationship with Jack. Some productions give Milky White a spoken or sung moment.
avoid: Vocal audition showcase — this role is entirely about physical performance and character puppetry

songs_to_prepare.title: Some Things Are Meant to Be
songs_to_prepare.why: Shows a large, powerful voice that can convey both grief and terrifying authority — the Giant's wife is mourning

into-the-woods/the-giant.style_guidance: The Giant is an amplified voice-only or enormous physical role — requires a voice that fills every corner of the theatre with both terror and grief. She is not a monster; she is bereaved.
avoid: Roaring, cartoon monster approach — the Giant's Wife is grieving, not malicious

songs_to_prepare.title: Big Girls Don't Cry
songs_to_prepare.why: The signature Four Seasons sound — requires the authentic falsetto that defines this role

songs_to_prepare.title: Can't Take My Eyes Off You
songs_to_prepare.why: Shows the tenor's full range from chest to falsetto — the climactic number every Frankie must nail

songs_to_prepare.title: Oh, What a Night
songs_to_prepare.why: Shows period pop tenor energy and the ability to carry the Four Seasons sound authentically

songs_to_prepare.title: How Deep Is Your Love
songs_to_prepare.composer: Barry Gibb / Maurice Gibb / Robin Gibb
songs_to_prepare.why: If period pop is accepted — shows the sweet falsetto tenor that Frankie Valli requires

jersey-boys/frankie-valli.style_guidance: Frankie Valli is the most technically specific role in jukebox musical theatre — a genuine falsetto to C6 is non-negotiable. The role cannot be faked. Voice first, acting follows.
avoid: Falsetto approximations — either you have the Frankie Valli voice or this is not the role for you

songs_to_prepare.title: My Way
songs_to_prepare.composer: Claude François / Jacques Revaux / Paul Anka
songs_to_prepare.why: If pop songs are accepted — Tommy's entire arc condensed, the unapologetic mobster who made it on his terms

songs_to_prepare.title: Luck Be a Lady
songs_to_prepare.why: Low baritone with swagger and criminal adjacent confidence — the street smart operator

songs_to_prepare.title: Sit Down, John
songs_to_prepare.why: Commanding baritone who leads through personality and intimidation — Tommy demanding his due

songs_to_prepare.title: Master of the House
songs_to_prepare.why: The charming operator who manipulates everyone around him through personality — Tommy's mode

jersey-boys/tommy-devito.style_guidance: Tommy is the dangerous charm at the heart of the Four Seasons story — low baritone with street authority and natural criminality. He needs to be persuasive enough that everyone keeps following him despite themselves.
avoid: Clean-cut or guileless energy — Tommy's appeal is his knowingness and implied threat

songs_to_prepare.title: Short People
songs_to_prepare.why: If pop songs accepted — the clever wit of the group's songwriter and intellectual heart

songs_to_prepare.title: Corner of the Sky
songs_to_prepare.why: The young composer finding his place and his purpose — bright tenor who carries the harmony

songs_to_prepare.title: Till There Was You
songs_to_prepare.why: Period-adjacent lyric tenor — warm, clean, the emotional anchor of the group

jersey-boys/bob-gaudio.style_guidance: Bob Gaudio is the Four Seasons' moral compass and artistic engine — tenor with intelligence, steadiness, and the songwriting soul. He narrates a significant portion; clarity and warmth are essential.
avoid: Tommy's street energy — Bob is the deal-maker who keeps his word, the opposite of Tommy's chaos

songs_to_prepare.title: Old Man River

jersey-boys/jersey-francine.style_guidance: Francine is Frankie's troubled daughter — soprano/mezzo who carries the personal cost of the Four Seasons' success. Her tragedy is the show's emotional low point. Small but devastating role.

songs_to_prepare.title: Big Spender

jersey-boys/jersey-lorraine.style_guidance: Lorraine is a supporting female role in the world of the Four Seasons — one of the women who passes through. Soprano/mezzo with 1960s character and the ability to register quickly.

songs_to_prepare.title: Everything's Coming Up Roses
songs_to_prepare.why: The diva who is absolutely convinced of her own fabulous importance — mezzo belt, unearned confidence

songs_to_prepare.title: Don't Tell Mama
songs_to_prepare.why: The fun, irresponsible girl who is absolutely not going to let responsibility cramp her style

songs_to_prepare.title: Popular
songs_to_prepare.why: The girl who is certain she knows what matters (her) and will tell you at length — mezzo comedy

seussical/mayzie.style_guidance: Mayzie is the irresponsible diva — mezzo-soprano belt with maximum self-assurance, comedy, and zero guilt. She flies away from her egg without a second thought and floats back expecting everything to be fine.
avoid: Sympathetic victim reading — Mayzie chose the egg situation and then chose to leave it; the comedy is her complete lack of remorse

songs_to_prepare.title: Rose's Turn
songs_to_prepare.why: The community authority figure who will not tolerate deviation — alto/mezzo with self-righteous power belt

songs_to_prepare.title: Everything's Coming Up Roses
songs_to_prepare.why: The woman convinced her way is the only right way — control, power, and absolute certainty

songs_to_prepare.title: I Am What I Am
songs_to_prepare.why: The character who defines their community and will destroy opposition — alto with teeth

seussical/sour-kangaroo.style_guidance: The Sour Kangaroo is the conformist bully who rules the Jungle of Nool — alto/mezzo with genuine power belt and the ability to make conventional wisdom sound like gospel. She is wrong but absolutely convincing.
avoid: Comedic buffoon approach — the Kangaroo wields real social power and Horton's humiliation is real

songs_to_prepare.title: Cell Block Tango
songs_to_prepare.why: Trio of female voices delivering commentary with attitude — shows the snarky chorus female trio dynamic

songs_to_prepare.title: Be Our Guest
songs_to_prepare.why: Female trio ensemble with strong blend — the celebration/spectacle number the Bird Girls embody

seussical/seuss-bird-girls.style_guidance: The Bird Girls are the show's ironic Greek chorus — soprano/mezzo/alto trio with perfect blend and the ability to deliver social commentary with jazz-hand enthusiasm. Harmony skills and comedic timing essential.
avoid: Solo showcase approach — the Bird Girls are a trio and the magic is the blend and coordinated attitude

songs_to_prepare.title: I Am the Very Model
songs_to_prepare.why: Military authority character with puffed-up self-importance — the general who wants to boil Horton's clover

songs_to_prepare.title: Sit Down, John
songs_to_prepare.why: Commanding, dismissive baritone who has decided Horton's beliefs are dangerous nonsense

seussical/seuss-general-schmitz.style_guidance: General Schmitz is comic military authority — character baritone with maximum pomposity and the conviction that the kangaroo's law must be enforced. His threat is real even though he is funny.
avoid: Sympathetic character work — the General is the establishment arm of conformity and fully committed to it

songs_to_prepare.title: Razzle Dazzle
songs_to_prepare.why: Trio of energetic monkey troublemakers performing chaos with attitude — showmen of disruption

songs_to_prepare.title: Comedy Tonight
songs_to_prepare.from: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum
songs_to_prepare.why: Character trio who exist to create chaos and delight in it — tenor/baritone/bass comedic ensemble

seussical/seuss-wickershams.style_guidance: The Wickershams are the show's chaos agents — tenor/baritone/bass trio with physical energy, harmony skills, and the ability to be simultaneously irritating and entertaining. Perfect comic timing as a unit.
avoid: Solo hero moments — the Wickershams are an ensemble and their power is collective mischief

songs_to_prepare.title: Be Our Guest
songs_to_prepare.why: Character-specific ensemble who must each be a distinct Seuss creature — physical and vocal specificity

songs_to_prepare.title: Comedy Tonight
songs_to_prepare.from: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum
songs_to_prepare.why: Ensemble who must sell the show's world through pure theatrical commitment and variety

seussical/ensemble-seuss.style_guidance: Seussical ensemble plays an enormous range of creatures — the key is character specificity (what KIND of creature are you?) and ensemble blend. Strong voices, strong physicality, strong imagination.
avoid: Generic ensemble approach — every Seussical creature should feel individually designed and specific

songs_to_prepare.title: And I Am Telling You I'm Not Going
songs_to_prepare.why: The great R&B-soul mezzo belt powerhouse — Deloris's voice type and theatrical DNA exactly

songs_to_prepare.title: Ain't No Mountain High Enough
songs_to_prepare.why: If Motown/R&B accepted — the soul-gospel energy Deloris brings to everything she touches

songs_to_prepare.title: Don't Rain on My Parade
songs_to_prepare.why: The unstoppable woman with a big voice and bigger plans — Deloris before the convent

songs_to_prepare.title: Defying Gravity
songs_to_prepare.why: Contemporary mezzo belt — the woman who decides to transform a situation through sheer force of personality

sister-act/sister-act-deloris.style_guidance: Deloris needs a mezzo-soprano with genuine R&B/gospel belt and enormous stage presence — the kind of voice and personality that turns a convent choir into a show choir against everyone's better judgment.
avoid: Classical or legit soprano material — Deloris is R&B/gospel soul, the further from legit the better

songs_to_prepare.title: Children Will Listen
songs_to_prepare.why: The authority figure who takes responsibility for her flock seriously — mezzo/alto with genuine gravitas

songs_to_prepare.title: Climb Ev'ry Mountain
songs_to_prepare.why: The most famous Mother Superior song in musical theatre — and a benchmark for the required vocal authority

songs_to_prepare.title: Being Alive
songs_to_prepare.why: Shows the inner world of a woman who chose a constrained life because she believed in it — mezzo depth

sister-act/sister-act-mother-superior.style_guidance: Mother Superior begins as the antagonist and becomes a champion — mezzo/alto with absolute conviction, natural authority, and the capacity for a real arc. Her moment of joining Deloris is the show's turning point.
avoid: Rigid, unemotional performance — Mother Superior's journey is about learning to trust and expand, never about being permanently wrong

songs_to_prepare.title: Luck Be a Lady
songs_to_prepare.why: The mob boss who believes the universe belongs to him — baritone/tenor with swagger and criminal authority

songs_to_prepare.title: Master of the House
songs_to_prepare.why: The charming criminal enterprise leader who runs everything and enjoys it enormously

songs_to_prepare.title: Stars
songs_to_prepare.why: The implacable pursuer who cannot accept that someone slipped out of his control — villain's conviction

sister-act/sister-act-curtis.style_guidance: Curtis is the villain who is more comic than terrifying — baritone/tenor with gangster swagger and the specific comedy of a Seventies crime boss who is genuinely baffled that anyone would choose a convent over him.
avoid: Genuinely menacing villain approach — Curtis is the loveable obstacle, not a real threat

songs_to_prepare.title: Corner of the Sky
songs_to_prepare.why: The young man who has loved from a distance and finally gets his moment — lyric tenor with warmth

songs_to_prepare.title: I Feel Pretty
songs_to_prepare.why: The sweetly awkward person discovering they are loved — tenor with genuine, bumbling warmth

songs_to_prepare.title: Till There Was You
songs_to_prepare.why: The gentle, earnest tenor who has finally noticed something wonderful — Eddie and Deloris

sister-act/sister-act-eddie.style_guidance: Eddie is the sweetheart cop who has loved Deloris his entire life — tenor with natural warmth, awkward charm, and the ability to be the best person in any room without knowing it.
avoid: Cool or confident material — Eddie's charm is his awkwardness and genuine heart

songs_to_prepare.title: Glitter and Be Gay
songs_to_prepare.why: The hidden soprano talent released from behind her veil — the voice that was there all along

songs_to_prepare.title: I Could Have Danced All Night
songs_to_prepare.why: The awakened young soprano who has discovered joy through transformation — Mary Robert's arc

songs_to_prepare.title: Defying Gravity
songs_to_prepare.why: The soprano who discovers she is more than her constraints — belt emerging from behind years of silence

sister-act/sister-act-mary-robert.style_guidance: Mary Robert is the show's secret weapon — a soprano with hidden belt who has been quiet her whole life and is about to find her voice. The arc from timid to triumphant depends entirely on the quality of her vocal revelation.
avoid: Showing the belt too early — the whole performance arc is about the slow emergence of what has always been there

songs_to_prepare.title: Adelaide's Lament
songs_to_prepare.why: The long-suffering church-music veteran dealing with the absolute chaos of the new regime

songs_to_prepare.title: I'm Going Back
songs_to_prepare.why: Character alto who knows how things should be done and has had QUITE enough of innovation

sister-act/sister-act-mary-lazarus.style_guidance: Sister Mary Lazarus is the musical comedy backbone — alto/mezzo character voice with comic timing, physical expressiveness, and the specific comedy of theatrical old-church resistance to change.
avoid: Warm or supportive material — Mary Lazarus believes everything was better before Deloris arrived, and she will tell you so at length

songs_to_prepare.title: Tomorrow
songs_to_prepare.why: Irrepressible optimism from a soprano who is enthusiastic about everything including being hit by a car

songs_to_prepare.title: I Enjoy Being a Girl
songs_to_prepare.why: Cheerful soprano who is completely thrilled by everything including the idea of being transformed into a disco nun

sister-act/sister-act-mary-patrick.style_guidance: Sister Mary Patrick is joy in a habit — soprano who is enthusiastic about everything with zero filter and maximum commitment. She is the first to embrace Deloris. The comedy is her complete sincerity.
avoid: Irenic or measured quality — Mary Patrick operates entirely at maximum enthusiasm

songs_to_prepare.title: Comedy Tonight
songs_to_prepare.from: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum
songs_to_prepare.why: The institutional authority figure being completely outmanoeuvred by events — baritone with comic helplessness

songs_to_prepare.title: Sit Down, John
songs_to_prepare.why: The churchman trying to maintain dignity while his convent becomes a disco — exhausted baritone authority

sister-act/sister-act-monsignor.style_guidance: The Monsignor is the well-meaning church authority who is completely out of his depth with Deloris — baritone with natural dignity and the specific comedy of institutional irrelevance in the face of joyful chaos.
avoid: Villainous or obstructive energy — the Monsignor means well; he is just completely unable to handle the situation

songs_to_prepare.title: Raise Your Voice
songs_to_prepare.why: The nun ensemble transformation number — shows the gospel-infused choir sound the show requires

songs_to_prepare.title: Joyful, Joyful
songs_to_prepare.composer: Ludwig van Beethoven / arr. Mervyn Warren
songs_to_prepare.why: Gospel-choir energy — the soul-infused choral style the convent ultimately adopts

songs_to_prepare.title: And I Am Telling You
songs_to_prepare.why: Gospel-adjacent soprano/mezzo ensemble belt — shows the voice type the show needs

sister-act/sister-act-nun-ensemble.style_guidance: The nun ensemble begins as a struggling church choir and becomes a gospel powerhouse — the arc requires genuine choral singers who can also belt gospel-style by Act Two. Versatility from hymn to soul is the core skill.
avoid: Static, unexpressive choral singing — the ensemble's transformation from grey to brilliant is the show's central visual and sonic story

songs_to_prepare.title: And I Am Telling You I'm Not Going
songs_to_prepare.why: The original wife's absolute refusal to accept being replaced — fierce mezzo belt that mirrors Aragon's declaration

songs_to_prepare.title: Defying Gravity
songs_to_prepare.why: The woman who refuses to be written out of her own story — powerful mezzo belt to E5, unbreakable conviction

songs_to_prepare.title: Don't Rain on My Parade
songs_to_prepare.why: Contemporary MT powerhouse — the unstoppable woman who will not yield no matter what, driving belt with charisma

six/catherine-aragon.style_guidance: Aragon opens the show and sets the standard — mezzo-soprano with a power belt that can cut through a rock band. Her energy is fierce, righteous, and entirely contemporary despite the Tudor setting. This is a concert belt, not a legit tone.
avoid: Classical or period vocal approach — Six is entirely contemporary pop/rock, no vibrato-heavy legit soprano

songs_to_prepare.title: Popular
songs_to_prepare.why: Witty, self-aware, and delightfully oblivious to the danger around her — Anne's comic pop energy exactly

songs_to_prepare.title: Don't Rain on My Parade
songs_to_prepare.why: The unstoppable girl who is absolutely certain of her greatness right up until she isn't

songs_to_prepare.title: Gimme Gimme
songs_to_prepare.why: Pop-adjacent belt anthem with contemporary sensibility and enormous confidence — Anne's vibe in song format

six/anne-boleyn.style_guidance: Anne Boleyn is Six's comedian — mezzo-soprano pop belt with irrepressible wit, comedic timing, and the ability to make you laugh at jokes about her own execution. She is the most fun queen, which makes her tragedy land harder.
avoid: Tragic or vulnerable tone — Anne's whole character is that she refuses to be defined by what happened to her

songs_to_prepare.title: She Used to Be Mine
songs_to_prepare.why: The quiet, emotional power ballad about a woman who knew who she was before circumstances changed her

songs_to_prepare.title: On My Own
songs_to_prepare.why: The woman who loved genuinely and never got to see how the story ended — soprano/mezzo ballad with controlled emotion

songs_to_prepare.title: I Dreamed a Dream
songs_to_prepare.why: The queen who had what she always wanted and didn't survive to enjoy it — mezzo/soprano ballad, genuine tragedy

six/jane-seymour.style_guidance: Jane Seymour is the show's emotional centre — soprano/mezzo with a genuine ballad quality that stops the concert dead. 'Heart of Stone' is Six's power ballad and Jane needs to deliver the full emotional weight. Authentic vulnerability, not performance of sadness.
avoid: Pop performer energy — Jane is the one queen who plays it completely straight and the contrast to her sisters is essential

songs_to_prepare.title: Anything You Can Do
songs_to_prepare.why: The queen who won the game of Henry's marriages and refuses to pretend otherwise — competitive, confident mezzo

songs_to_prepare.title: I Am What I Am
songs_to_prepare.why: The woman fully and gloriously at peace with exactly who she is — alto/mezzo owning the room

songs_to_prepare.title: I Feel Pretty
songs_to_prepare.why: Contrasting — the woman who was told she was unwanted and built herself a better life regardless

six/anna-cleves.style_guidance: Anna of Cleves got divorced and kept the money and the freedom — mezzo/alto with hip-hop flow, maximum confidence, and absolute zero emotional damage. She won. She knows she won. The comedy is entirely grounded in how correct she is.
avoid: Victimhood or vulnerability — Anna is the show's winner and she knows it; any hint of damage undermines the entire character

songs_to_prepare.title: I Know Things Now
songs_to_prepare.why: The youngest, who learned too late that the world was dangerous — soprano with the specific vulnerability of youth betrayed

songs_to_prepare.title: Popular
songs_to_prepare.why: Shows the social butterfly soprano energy — the girl who used her looks and paid the price for it

songs_to_prepare.title: Gimme Gimme
songs_to_prepare.why: Contemporary pop soprano belt — young woman wanting something from the world she thought she could access

six/katherine-howard.style_guidance: Katherine Howard is the youngest of the queens and the show's most heartbreaking story — soprano pop belt with an irresistibly fun surface that gradually reveals the cost of her circumstances. She is not naive; she simply had no other options.
avoid: Pure tragedy — Katherine's number 'All You Wanna Do' is deliberately pop-fun on the surface; the horror comes from what she's describing underneath

songs_to_prepare.title: Being Alive
songs_to_prepare.why: The final queen who refuses to let her story be reduced — mezzo with building emotional intelligence and declaration

songs_to_prepare.title: I Am What I Am
songs_to_prepare.why: The survivor claiming her narrative — alto/mezzo declaration that builds to a full belt

songs_to_prepare.title: Don't Rain on My Parade
songs_to_prepare.why: The woman who refuses to be a punchline — driving mezzo belt with intelligence and determination

six/catherine-parr.style_guidance: Catherine Parr closes the show — mezzo/alto with a building belt, emotional intelligence, and the ability to speak directly to the audience about how women's stories get told. She is the most politically explicit queen and needs genuine gravity.
avoid: Light pop energy — Parr is the philosopher and activist of the six; she needs weight and purpose, not just charisma

songs_to_prepare.title: She Used to Be Mine
songs_to_prepare.why: Jenna's own defining song — mezzo-soprano with contemporary pop-musical quality, quiet devastation building to a belt

songs_to_prepare.title: Still Hurting
songs_to_prepare.why: A woman processing a painful relationship with raw emotional honesty — contemporary mezzo, exactly Jenna's world

songs_to_prepare.title: I Dreamed a Dream
songs_to_prepare.why: The woman who had a vision of herself that life tried to take — mezzo with belt, accessible emotion

songs_to_prepare.title: What I Did for Love
songs_to_prepare.why: Mezzo-soprano with quiet dignity — Jenna at her most reflective, before she finds her way out

waitress/waitress-jenna.style_guidance: Jenna is trapped in an abusive marriage and finds freedom through baking and a doomed affair — mezzo-soprano with a pop-musical quality, warm chest voice, and a belt that reveals her internal fire only when she can no longer hold it back.
avoid: Big showy belt songs — Jenna's power is concealed until it has to come out; the build matters enormously

songs_to_prepare.title: And I Am Telling You I'm Not Going

songs_to_prepare.title: Before the Parade Passes By
songs_to_prepare.why: The woman who is done with small choices — big mezzo declaration of claiming her own life

songs_to_prepare.title: I'm Still Here

waitress/waitress-becky.style_guidance: Becky is the diner's soul — alto/mezzo with a real belt and the kind of truth-telling warmth that comes from experience. She supports Jenna and has her own story. Big voice, bigger heart, zero tolerance for self-pity.
avoid: Sweet or restrained material — Becky is direct, warm, and refuses to soften her truth

songs_to_prepare.title: Adelaide's Lament
songs_to_prepare.why: The sweetly anxious woman whose emotional situation manifests physically — mezzo comedy with genuine heart

songs_to_prepare.title: Much More
songs_to_prepare.why: The dreaming young woman who wants to be swept off her feet — soprano/mezzo imagining the life she wants

songs_to_prepare.title: I Feel Pretty
songs_to_prepare.why: The awkward woman discovering she is suddenly, wonderfully loved — mezzo-soprano with charming self-surprise

waitress/waitress-dawn.style_guidance: Dawn is the show's comic romantic — awkward, over-analytical, and completely won over by a man who is just as much of both things. Mezzo-soprano with natural comedy and accessible vulnerability. Her love story is the show's purest joy.
avoid: Cool or sophisticated material — Dawn is the opposite of cool; her awkwardness is her superpower

songs_to_prepare.title: All I Ask of You
songs_to_prepare.why: Romantic tenor/baritone in a complicated situation — the doctor who walks into something he cannot control

songs_to_prepare.title: Giants in the Sky
